scope: Versioned formal reports with single administrator approval, dedicated database accounts and explicit publication; existing personal reports retain per-viewer credentials.

browser.target: Final production backend and nginx images with real PostgreSQL and three real application roles.
browser.execution: Canonical formal and personal scripts rerun in a retained isolated acceptance runtime after fixing popup selection helpers; fresh fixtures used suffix _acceptance. Final frontend container used the image directly without bind mounts.
formal_checks: administrator creates and validates an encrypted independent report account
developer converts a personal report, previews with a personal account and submits an immutable chart version
administrator validates the selected account and audience before approval and explicit publication
unbound business viewer runs a published chart without seeing SQL or credentials, including mobile
saving a new working draft leaves the approved production version unchanged
administrator rejects a changed version with an explicit reason and preserves the live release
explicit unpublication blocks execution and rollback restores a previously approved version
account disable blocks live execution and removing the author connection does not remove the report
no browser script errors across the real multi-account workflow
durable audit identifies the business viewer and the actual report database account
personal_regression_checks: independent creation previews a real read-only query and saves a shared chart
view executes the saved definition through the dedicated report route and exposes chart source rows
concurrent edits produce a visible conflict without overwriting the saved definition
line, pie and metric charts render complete real query results without client aggregation
large integers, high precision decimals and JSON cell numbers retain their exact values
truncation is explicit, row 1000 remains reachable, and the mobile page fits the viewport
a real SQL error is visible and does not masquerade as an empty or old result
readonly viewer uses a personal binding and keeps access after the publisher deletes their connection
unbound owner cannot borrow viewer credentials and anonymous sharing remains disabled
all real browser paths finish without page script errors

production_runtime.frontend_packaging: Final dist built with pinned Node 24.12.0 in the existing Docker development service, then packaged using the unchanged nginx runtime stage from the repository Dockerfile; used to limit VFS build cache disk consumption.

boundaries: Single-level approval, fixed readonly SQL, at most 1000 rows and 30 seconds subject to stricter limits.
Report viewers require the approved audience ACL but no personal database binding; shared database credentials do not provide per-viewer database row policies.
Administrator must use a constrained database account and review its actual result scope before approval.
Native PostgreSQL/MySQL and PostgreSQL JDBC were tested; this change did not recreate openGauss or claim real GaussDB validation.
Local synthetic fixtures only; no business load, enterprise tenant isolation or external deployment acceptance.
Multi-level workflows, dynamic parameters, schedules, anonymous access and result caching remain outside this phase.
